summary: The first C owner is pray.c:dosacrifice(): it reads the altar alignment through the a_align macro before selecting the corpse. C rm.h aliases altarmask to flags, while JS mklev.js:create_altar stores the mask in location.flags and js/pray.js:a_align reads only location.altarmask. The JS path therefore sees A_NONE instead of the lawful altar and takes a different-alignment offering branch. Correct the shared a_align helper while preserving the exact A_NONE/lawful/neutral/chaotic mapping. After that fix, the negative-offering path still reaches the separately unported pray.c:offer_negative_valued().

source.branch: In dosacrifice(), before floorfood("sacrifice", 1), a_align(u.ux, u.uy) must read the current altar mask and apply AM_MASK. For an altar mask AM_LAWFUL (0x04), Amask2align returns A_LAWFUL (1); with the white unicorn corpse, eval_offering sees sgn(maligntyp) == altaralign, prints the insult to law, and returns -1. The current JS helper reads only location.altarmask although special-level altar creation stores the shared C field in location.flags, so it converts zero to A_NONE and selects the cross-alignment path.
callers: cmd.c:1776 extended-command row maps #offer to dosacrifice(); JavaScript dispatches dosacrifice through js/cmd.js:5185-5189.
cmd.c:4828-4830 queues dosacrifice() for MCMD_OFFER; JavaScript handles MCMD.OFFER in js/cmd.js:4728.
dependencies: pray.c:107 a_align macro reads levl[x][y].altarmask & AM_MASK; rm.h:214 defines altarmask as an alias of flags.
align.h:46-48 Amask2align preserves A_NONE, A_LAWFUL, A_NEUTRAL, and A_CHAOTIC as distinct aligntyp values.
eat.c:floorfood() returns the selected offering used by dosacrifice().
pray.c:offer_corpse() receives the corpse, highaltar flag, and resolved altaralign.
pray.c:eval_offering() returns the negative value for a unicorn whose sign-alignment matches the altar.
pray.c:offer_negative_valued() is the next void helper on this negative branch; its same-alignment path calls gods_upset(), then angrygods().
dat/Arc-loca.lua:68-70 supplies the altar alignment; sp_lev.c:lspo_altar() and create_altar() store it in the C rm.altarmask/flags field.

evidence: The supplied C recording challenges/cases/v15/lawful-aligned-unicorn-insults-at-lawful-altar.session.json reaches the #offer confirmation at segment 0 step 124. At step 125, after y, C prints “Such an action is an insult to law!” and records rn2(3)=2 at angrygods(pray.c:725), followed by rn2(4)=1 at godvoice(pray.c:1425). This is the source path eval_offering() returning -1, offer_corpse() calling offer_negative_valued(), and gods_upset() incrementing u.ugangr before angrygods().

The saved diagnostic .cache/synthetic-scans/v15/lawful-aligned-unicorn-insults-at-lawful-altar.json identifies the first mismatch at segment 0, step 125 and records pray.c:offer_different_alignment_altar as the JS unported path. That path is consistent with the altar being read as A_NONE rather than lawful; the RNG annotation angrygods(pray.c:725) is downstream evidence, not the first owner.

C source pray.c:1854-1896 computes altaralign with a_align(u.ux, u.uy) before floorfood() and passes it to offer_corpse(). The macro at pray.c:107 masks AM_MASK before Amask2align(). C source align.h:46-48 maps mask zero to A_NONE, AM_LAWFUL (0x04) to A_LAWFUL, AM_NEUTRAL (0x02) to A_NEUTRAL, and AM_CHAOTIC (0x01) to A_CHAOTIC; do not collapse unaligned and neutral or infer altar alignment from truthiness.

C source dat/Arc-loca.lua:68-70 defines three altars from the shuffled align array. C sp_lev.c:lspo_altar() at :4283-4315 calls create_altar(), whose :2443-2471 path stores the altar mask in levl[x][y].altarmask. In rm.h:214, altarmask aliases flags. The corresponding JS mklev.js:create_altar() stores the mask in location.flags, while game.js:makeLocation() has a flags field and no separate altarmask alias.

The defective JS reader is js/pray.js:a_align() at lines 296-298: it passes state.level.at(x, y).altarmask & AM_MASK to Amask2align(), with no flags fallback. By contrast, js/pray.js:altarmask_at() at lines 303-313 already reads location.altarmask ?? location.flags ?? 0. A source-backed divergence fix should make a_align() read that same single stored C field and apply AM_MASK before conversion; the shared helper also serves the other pray.c a_align macro call sites.

The whole source function for the first owner is pray.c:dosacrifice() (1854-1896), reached by #offer and the listed sacrifice dispatchers. After correcting the alignment input, the C path continues into pray.c:offer_negative_valued() (1592-1599), which is still a separate note_unported gap in js/pray.js:678; keep that downstream behavior visible when measuring the corrected first mismatch.
